review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for this frozen C bundle. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, repository identity, base commit, exact writable owner scopes, and evidence stages agree with the original specification. C explicitly fixes hypothetical OPT-1 without asserting a human Decision; only the selected branch is mandatory. The paired B scenario must still block at decisions while material DEC-001 remains unresolved. The source supports per-registration wrappers and a fired guard against stale-snapshot reentrancy while preserving ordinary and wildcard ordering, exception propagation, and existing off contracts. Configuration and supplied upstream build evidence support treating index.d.ts and dist as generated artifacts rather than separately maintained owners, with build preceding runtime and type verification. The two task expectations preserve implementation and dependent independent verification, and the allowed agents have the supplied active trusted claims needed for the bounded synchronous source/test scope, including data.change and domain.state and verifier-only testing.verification. An independent active project reviewer is present for the earlier high-risk review prerequisite; execution capability is not required for that inspection role. Ready therefore describes planning readiness, not completed execution or authorization to dispatch. Gold and preview release fingerprints match; the distinct manifest, evaluation-source, and normalized PRD digest domains are explicitly reconciled by the supplied Service provenance. Repository, team, decision, prompt, model, sampling, policy, and budget fingerprints are supplied consistently. No candidate outputs informed this review. I reviewed the supplied evidence only, did not execute code or independently recompute digests, and do not confer a human attestation.
